sam_j: Ok team — Argento POC kicked off today. Sales asked for a one-pager: success criteria, owner matrix, golden prompt set, and regression gates. Who can own the scoring rubric and who owns security answers?

liz_de: I can own the success criteria doc and the stakeholder matrix. I'll put together an owners table (sales / DE / SE / Sec / IT). quick Q: do they need Dedicated or Hosted for the trial?

maria_se: Hosted to start (they want quick turn). We should offer Dedicated as an option for scale/SLAs later. For success criteria propose 3 use cases: 1) customer support triage, 2) automated form filling, 3) contract clause extraction.

sam_j: perfect. Maria, can you draft the 3 golden prompts per use case and a simple scoring rubric? target: >= 85% pass rate on goldens for go/no-go.

maria_se: will do. rough example prompts (for initial review):
```
# Support triage
"Summarize the user issue and output: [category], [urgency: low/med/high], [1-line resolution suggestion]"
# Contract extraction
"Extract the payment terms: output JSON with {term, amount, frequency, penalty}"
```

tao_ml: I'll take scoring. proposed multi-signal rubric:
- automated metric: token-level F1 / field-extraction exact-match for structured outputs
- semantic metric: embedding cosine >= 0.85 for freeform answers
- human spot-check: 10% sample CRR (customer rating) >= 4/5
Regression gate: if goldens drop >5 percentage points vs baseline -> block rollout and open regression ticket.

liz_de: owners: success criteria (liz_de), golden prompts (maria_se), scoring (tao_ml), security Q (ben_ops), infra config + pricing (sam_j). added to the matrix.

ben_ops: added Sec notes: Argento requires KMS + VPC peering + SOC2 + data residency eu-west. Need to fill their infosec questionnaire and add an audit window. I attached the questionnaire link: https://intranet.redwood/sec-questionnaires/argento-2026 (placeholder). Also: encryption at rest with customer-managed keys required.

sam_j: pricing question from procurement: can we run 2 weeks free trial on Hosted and bill Dedicated only if they commit? econ asks for a delta estimate if they move to Dedicated. 

liz_de: yes we can. I'll model two scenarios and share delta % (expected 12-18% uplift for Dedicated commit, depending on reserved capacity).

maria_se: prompt-set design notes: keep goldens small (20-50 examples per use case), include corner cases, label expected outputs, and include adversarial negatives. We'll store as CSV with columns: prompt, expected_output, tags, difficulty.

tao_ml: suggested automatic scoring snippet (example pseudocode):
```python
# compute field-exact score for contract extraction
def exact_match_score(pred, gold):
    return sum(1 for k in gold if pred.get(k)==gold[k]) / len(gold)
```
Regression trigger: create alert when rolling average drops more than 5 pts over baseline for 1 hour.

ben_ops: I'll take the questionnaire and start filling. also need a pointer to the data retention table and subprocessor list from legal. Sam, can you loop in legal?

sam_j: looping @legal via email now.

ops-bot: Meeting scheduled: Argento POC sync — Wed 10am PT — invites sent. :calendar:

liz_de: next actions (TL;DR):
- maria_se: deliver draft golden prompts + CSV by Tue EOD
- tao_ml: deliver scoring scripts + baseline expected by Tue EOD
- ben_ops: draft infosec answers + KMS plan by Wed morning
- liz_de: success criteria one-pager + owner matrix by Wed morning
- sam_j: pricing scenarios and contract handoff by Wed EOD

maria_se: noted, will include a small example CSV and 15 initial goldens per use case. sample row format: prompt | expected | tags | difficulty

tao_ml: will instrument continuous eval and add a dashboard tile for pass rate per-use-case.

sam_j: thanks all. If anyone hits blockers call out here. Want to present this in Wed sync and get signoff to run the 2-week hosted trial. :thumbsup:
